changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6d: scheduler/service.ts renamed to index.ts and scheduler/mcp-delegate.ts to mcp.ts (matching the agent/team/workflow-service per-domain template); a new requests.ts holds the request readers and result projections previously split across types.ts and store.ts, which is now persistence-only; the dead dispatcherId option/parameter was dropped from CronJobStore and detectLegacyCronJobStore; the fire path was consolidated onto one store read per fire plus a pure advanceJob/impure rearm pair (a one-shot job whose dispatch throws is now disabled immediately instead of staying enabled with a stale next_run_at until the next start()); and SchedulerService now implements SchedulerCommands directly, with TeamService composing its own closing fence directly into the admit closure it passes at construction instead of wrapping the public command surface in a second, Team-scoped object.
